cases.note: Monty has no os.makedirs, os.walk, os.scandir or shutil.

program.python:
import os
import shutil
os.makedirs('/data/x/y/z')
os.makedirs('/data/x/y', exist_ok=True)
open('/data/x/y/z/f.txt', 'w').write('f')
open('/data/x/g.txt', 'w').write('g')
print([(d, sorted(ds), sorted(fs)) for d, ds, fs in os.walk('/data/x')])
print(sorted((e.name, e.is_dir(), e.is_file()) for e in os.scandir('/data/x')))
shutil.copy('/data/x/g.txt', '/data/x/h.txt')
shutil.move('/data/x/h.txt', '/data/x/y/h.txt')
shutil.copytree('/data/x/y', '/data/x/w')
shutil.rmtree('/data/x/y')
print(sorted(os.listdir('/data/x')), sorted(os.listdir('/data/x/w')), open('/data/x/w/h.txt').read())
program.node:
const fsp = require('node:fs').promises
await fsp.mkdir('/data/x/y/z', { recursive: true })
await fsp.mkdir('/data/x/y', { recursive: true })
await fsp.writeFile('/data/x/y/z/f.txt', 'f')
await fsp.writeFile('/data/x/g.txt', 'g')
console.log(JSON.stringify((await fsp.readdir('/data/x', { withFileTypes: true })).map((e) => [e.name, e.isDirectory(), e.isFile()]).sort()))
await fsp.copyFile('/data/x/g.txt', '/data/x/h.txt')
await fsp.rename('/data/x/h.txt', '/data/x/y/h.txt')
await fsp.mkdir('/data/x/w/z', { recursive: true })
await fsp.copyFile('/data/x/y/h.txt', '/data/x/w/h.txt')
await fsp.copyFile('/data/x/y/z/f.txt', '/data/x/w/z/f.txt')
await fsp.rm('/data/x/y', { recursive: true })
console.log(JSON.stringify((await fsp.readdir('/data/x')).sort()), JSON.stringify((await fsp.readdir('/data/x/w')).sort()), await fsp.readFile('/data/x/w/h.txt', 'utf8'))
